cases.scenario: 同一内容同时收藏、读过、被分享
cases.expected: 一个内容结果包含多个来源入口；不同消息不被误合并
cases.actual: Four real local stores, owner-only POST queries and current-source checks are implemented. Store/route/component and real-node browser checks provide partial evidence; scale timing and process recovery are recorded separately. Full permission/privacy, keyboard, offline and packaged desktop acceptance remain unfinished. 2026-09-14 actual Chrome/two-node follow-up: reused real prior A/C pairing, shared an article through the UI, searched only card metadata before an explicit receiver download, then found one saved/history/share result. Holding the old encrypted index file unchanged through sender-initiated revocation still filtered both protected message results and rejected their direct opens with 409. Independent saved body remained 200 with the same digest; after index recovery and receiver restart with sender/source offline, saved/history search and browser reading remained available, while old message URLs showed access removed. No product code changed and existing performance/unit checks were not repeated. Evidence covers online loopback notification, not public-NAT latency, packaged desktops or complete common gates.

cases.scenario: 修改、增加和删除记录
cases.expected: 索引正常时建议 5 秒内更新；删除后旧索引也不能继续返回正文片段
cases.actual: Original TCP rename took 6.930s. After reducing worker completion delay to 1s, two TCP samples created in 4.095/2.326s and renamed in 4.108/4.827s. Old title/deleted snippets hidden on first query; deleted direct-open denied with 409. Broader mutation paths and general gates remain pending. Damaged document metadata/body/control/timestamps are isolated from healthy search results, with explicit bounded source warnings. Stale index queries and direct opens do not disclose pending-cleanup bodies. Windows browser checks show two healthy results during one damaged copy, normal reading and Settings recovery access; fixture restoration recovers all three results and removes the warning. Final backend 1393 passed / 29 skipped, frontend 216 passed; broader platform and full requirement acceptance remain incomplete. 2026-09-14: Search now uses no-store in both HTTP responses and frontend requests. Regression checks first reproduced the absent header/cache policy. Real production-node TCP acceptance created and deleted a synthetic conversation via Owner API: nine success/error responses forbid caching, original open returns 200 then 409 after deletion and the query becomes empty. A separate real-store regression verifies deletion gating while the stale index still exists. Scoped backend 24 and frontend 13 checks passed; TypeScript/build passed. This does not measure actual browser cache retention, cross-node revocation, complete traffic/log privacy or packaged platforms.

A copied interrupted baseline resumed 5000 remaining receipts, then 100 rebookmarks took 61.130 seconds, above target. Caching only the complete validated deletion-receipt digest reduced repeated validation; a separate copy of the same interrupted baseline completed recovery and the same 100 changes in 56.831 seconds (44.193 writes + 12.638 transfer/final status), 200 receipts and 164476 encrypted JSON bytes, with all 10000 causal entities and changed values checked. A uses v4, B v3. First failure and over-target evidence remain; initial merge/whole cleanup were not remeasured. AI download overlapped, frontend tests ended before incremental timing, and backend full regression started afterwards. Packaged/physical/cross-network gates remain incomplete.

cases.actual: Source adapters, bilateral pairing, scoped encrypted HTTP batches, source-before-receipt acknowledgement, policy revision fencing and fresh pairing receipts are implemented. Automated fault checks and two-process loopback browser evidence cover transfer, readable original-provider history, search classification, confirmation status and receiver restart. Owner-reviewed reading/bookmark conflict choices now use stored candidates and revision checks. Browser selection converged across two loopback nodes and survived receiver restart. My reading now lists saved and synchronized positions; the shared reader reviews text-version mismatches and rejects stale progress writes. A real two-node browser reading position converged and survived receiver restart. Scale performance, complete erasure and packaged cross-network acceptance remain incomplete.

cases.scenario: 擦除会话范围，并检查本地恢复项及旧同步消息
cases.expected: 本地对应数据与恢复项被擦除，旧投递不复活；远端未确认删除明确显示未完成
cases.actual: Source adapters, bilateral pairing, scoped encrypted HTTP batches, source-before-receipt acknowledgement, policy revision fencing and fresh pairing receipts are implemented. Automated fault checks and two-process loopback browser evidence cover transfer, readable original-provider history, search classification, confirmation status and receiver restart. Owner-reviewed reading/bookmark conflict choices now use stored candidates and revision checks. Browser selection converged across two loopback nodes and survived receiver restart. My reading now lists saved and synchronized positions; the shared reader reviews text-version mismatches and rejects stale progress writes. A real two-node browser reading position converged and survived receiver restart. Scale performance, complete erasure and packaged cross-network acceptance remain incomplete. Internal reviewed conversation-source erasure is implemented in 5198d80. Related tests: 61 passed; stale delivery, terminal-task retry, new work after response loss, recovery copies and atomic failure are covered. Backups, derived indexes, order results, browser copies, complete export and the coordinated Settings flow remain incomplete; this is not full data-maintenance acceptance. Coordinated Owner-only conversation cleanup now persists source/replica/backup/search/order progress, resumes partial failures, reviews changed backups and retains source/consumer replay barriers. Real complete-node routes and the consumer result adapter are exercised; browser copies, Settings UI, full export, other scopes and remote acceptance remain incomplete. Settings now exposes reviewed conversation cleanup and durable resume; older browser copies have separate atomic erasure with deletion markers. Synthetic loopback browser checks cover cancellation, keyboard confirmation, node restart, browser reload and zero reimport. Final frontend 191 tests, TypeScript and build pass; full export, other scopes, cleanup-history capacity handling and remote/packaged acceptance remain incomplete. Cleanup history v2 now rotates only terminal summaries while retaining monotonic review generations and replay barriers (69d797b). Owner-selected ZIP exports cover nine product scopes, verified original documents and offline images, with an explicit manifest and exclusions. Loopback HTTP verifies every archive entry; browser checks cover keyboard download requests, layout correction, connection failure and same-node restart retry. Final backend: 1333 passed / 29 skipped; frontend: 198 passed. Other erasure scopes, unified legacy export, full account-data boundaries and packaged/remote acceptance remain incomplete. Reviewed reading cleanup now coordinates source, replica, known backups and search. Windows browser evidence covers held-file failure, node restart, changed-backup review, resume and retention of a new same-ID bookmark. Full data maintenance, v4 scale performance and packaged/remote acceptance remain incomplete.

cases.scenario: 干净安装
cases.expected: 全新数据目录，无历史、无模型、无好友时有正确入口和空状态

cases.scenario: 完整流程
cases.expected: 从实际页面入口完成用户任务，无需手工改配置文件或数据库

cases.scenario: 页面状态
cases.expected: 加载、空、错误、有内容均有测试；错误提供恢复动作，不无限转圈

cases.scenario: 重启恢复
cases.expected: 已保存数据仍在，中途操作可恢复或明确失败，不伪造完成

cases.scenario: 重复与并发
cases.expected: 连点、重试、重复投递不产生重复记录或结算；并发符合各文档规则

cases.scenario: 权限与隐私
cases.expected: 未授权请求由节点拒绝；私有内容、会话和秘密不进入普通日志、诊断或公开注册信息
cases.actual: 2026-09-14: Search now uses no-store in both HTTP responses and frontend requests. Regression checks first reproduced the absent header/cache policy. Real production-node TCP acceptance created and deleted a synthetic conversation via Owner API: nine success/error responses forbid caching, original open returns 200 then 409 after deletion and the query becomes empty. A separate real-store regression verifies deletion gating while the stale index still exists. Scoped backend 24 and frontend 13 checks passed; TypeScript/build passed. This does not measure actual browser cache retention, cross-node revocation, complete traffic/log privacy or packaged platforms.

cases.scenario: 可访问性
cases.expected: 主要流程可仅用键盘完成；弹窗焦点正确；状态不只靠颜色表达
cases.actual: 2026-09-14 actual Chrome keyboard follow-up reproduced focus falling to BODY after the last Load more button disappeared. Fixed pagination to focus the first new result, preserving focus if the user moved elsewhere while waiting. New build browser verification: 20 to 24 results, focused result index 20 opens its exact Ask message, and browser back retains keyword/type/source/sort plus scrollTop 2375 (scrollHeight 3245, clientHeight 870). Scoped frontend 15, TypeScript/build passed. Simulated Alt+Left did not navigate; the supported browser back tool verified restoration, not an end-to-end native keyboard shortcut. Date/friend filter combinations, complete keyboard and packaged-platform acceptance remain incomplete.

cases.scenario: 数据维护
cases.expected: 新数据纳入明确的导出/擦除范围；秘密不默认导出；升级保留原数据
cases.actual: Reviewed local conversation, reading, offline-download and friend-feed cleanup now have durable recovery; conversation browser copies have a separate flow. Nine selected product scopes export to ZIP with verified document and offline bytes, manifest and explicit exclusions. Real loopback browser checks cover confirmation, partial file deletion, node restart and original-operation retries preserving new work. Friend-feed cleanup additionally prevents old publication/refresh requests restoring cleared data; a polling-induced review failure was reproduced and fixed. Final regression: 1377 backend passed / 29 skipped; 211 frontend passed. Complete account-data maintenance, remaining erasure scopes, legacy export unification, v4 reading scale performance and packaged/remote acceptance remain incomplete. Managed document files now use a reviewed persistent cleanup receipt, source fencing and exact-file retries. Windows browser checks cover held-file failure, restart, changed-file approval and retention of later saved documents; completed-request replay preserves a same-ID copy recreated after completion. Search derived-copy coordination and other remaining personal-data ranges are not claimed complete.

cases.scenario: 故障隔离
cases.expected: 搜索、AI、好友或同步失败不使整个应用和已可用阅读一起失效
cases.actual: Damaged document metadata/body/control/timestamps are isolated from healthy search results, with explicit bounded source warnings. Stale index queries and direct opens do not disclose pending-cleanup bodies. Windows browser checks show two healthy results during one damaged copy, normal reading and Settings recovery access; fixture restoration recovers all three results and removes the warning. Final backend 1393 passed / 29 skipped, frontend 216 passed; broader platform and full requirement acceptance remain incomplete.

cases.scenario: 发布证据
cases.expected: 记录提交、平台、环境、步骤、预期/实际结果、耗时及限制；只声明实测范围
